newsitem.title: UK: North Sea exploration wells up 15.8 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: North Sea exploration wells up 15.8 pct in 1996.

text.p: A total of 88 exploration wells have been drilled in the North Sea so far in 1996, 15.8 percent more than in the same period last year, consultants Arthur Andersen said in a report.
On the appraisal side, 28 wells have been drilled so far this year, up 21.7 percent on last year.
The exploration level in the U.K. sector remains one higher than last year while levels in Norway are down by one.
The biggest change was in the Netherlands where exploration and appraisal wells are far higher this year than they were for the same period last year. The report gave no details.
